label: ndcgtree
charged: EVERY QUESTION IS CHARGED. Tree questions come from the same combined pool as the global build (top-500 popular items + top-500 answerable concepts); they burn an interview turn and their answers are folded into the recommender exactly like any other answer -- an asked-but-unrated item as the i26 native UNSEEN exposure token, an unanswerable concept as a cv3 refusal token. There is NO free side information in this arm and therefore NO generosity caveat: the total budget is 15 questions on both sides at every K.
min_leaf_justification: The MIN-LEAF RULE IS THE ONLY STOPPING RULE -- there is no depth cap. A node is not split if ANY of its three children would hold fewer than 200 validation users; growth otherwise continues until the interview budget itself runs out. Realised depth is a RESULT, not a setting. The 200 is empirical, from the genre-split experiment (2026-08-11): every genre group ABOVE 200 users held a positive gain when its order was carried to the TEST cohort, while every group BELOW it failed to generalise (Horror n=51 test -0.0013 ns; Crime n=79 test -0.0433; Fantasy n=11 test -0.1156). Applied to the CHOSEN splitter, not as a search constraint: if the argmax question shatters the node, the node STOPS -- it does not fall back to a worse question.
no_guarantee: A leaf's order must carry its ancestors' questions, which were chosen for their PARENTS' cohorts. The global order is therefore NOT inside a leaf's search space and a leaf CAN score below it. A negative leaf gain is a RESULT here, not a harness failure. The one mechanical guarantee is that the root splitter equals the global order's first question, so the K=1 difference is identically zero; that is asserted against the banked global build.
concept_answer_convention: Concept answer values follow the CERTIFIED-ERA convention that `concept_cv3_ep08` was trained under and that produced the comparator: uncapped signed values, with `cap_negatives` applied over the REVEALED set only, C_NEG read from the signed prereg. This is `build_greedy_env`'s own path and is checked against `signed_answers.cap_negatives` by `contract_selftest` at startup. (`--concept_neg_cap` is an `adaptive_harness` flag; it does not exist on this code path, and introducing one would put this arm on a different ruler from its own comparator.)
ruler_note: THE BANKED GLOBAL BUILD IS A POLICY-A ARTIFACT (measured 2026-08-12, this run's sanity gate). `greedy_static_i26c.json` records intercept.full = 0.12987336, which is the POLICY-A m=0 value; today's harness scores under POLICY B (2026-08-05 ruling, candidate_masking_protocol.md) and gives m=0 = 0.15686538 on the same 10,000 validation users. Its stored `gains` and `curve` are therefore on a DIFFERENT RULER and are NOT comparable to anything measured here -- numbers from different information contracts are not ordered. What IS used from that file is the SEQUENCE of questions, which is re-scored IN THIS RUN under policy B for every comparison (the same thing `group_greedy_genre.py` does). Residual caveat, stated rather than buried: the comparator's ORDER was selected under policy A, so it is not exactly 'the same objective under the same protocol'. Closing that would mean rebuilding the static combined order under policy B (~12 h).
criterion_note: NDCG@10 is per-user, so the node-size-weighted mean over the ternary partition is algebraically the node mean; the split search is therefore the greedy argmax restricted to the node's users, and this tree is MYOPIC in the same sense Golbandi's is. Adaptivity comes from the CHILDREN diverging, not from lookahead. Measured, not assumed: partition_decomposition_max_abs_err on every node.
nearest_prior_work: Hu & Yu, RecSys 2013, 'Interview Process Learning for Top-N Recommendation' -- an interview tree whose split loss may be a PAIRWISE RANK loss. Separations: smooth pairwise surrogate vs truncated discounted NDCG@10; training loss vs measured value of asking; MAP on 10x sampled negatives vs the full 18,359-item catalogue; static comparator top-k popular vs an order built by maximising the reported metric.
branch_rule: item: absent->noanswer, level>=7->like, else dislike | concept: not foldable->noanswer, signed value>0->like, else dislike
stopping_rule: min_leaf only (no depth cap); budget stops a node with 1 question left
headline_comparator_why: the global build's `combined` arm searches the SAME action space (500 pop items + 500 answerable concepts) with the SAME objective on the SAME cohort, so conditioning is the only thing that differs. `concepts-only` and `items-only` are reported alongside for continuity with the battery.
